programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Treasure Hunt. Justin and his friends go on a treasure hunt, and Mr Tumble's cake goes on an adventure!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Keep Fit. Preschool comedy and education. The Teletubbies feel tired after doing lots of keep-fit exercises but they are ready for action again after eating lots of Tubby Custard.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Soft Toy. Giovanna and Baby Bear invite babies and their grown-ups to explore soft toys through discovery, play, song and story.

programme.title: Maddie & Triggs
programme.desc: Where in the World. While helping Mum sort through some of the postcards on the fridge, Maddie and Triggs imagine themselves travelling all over the world with their very cool uncle.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Hair Stylist. Dylan the hair stylist wants to give his client a new hairstyle they'll love, but getting it just right is a lot harder than he thought.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Beautiful Flower. Lou sings a song about a flower, but Kiri's big pet rock Rockaroonie is rolling down the hill towards him! Can Kiri stop the rock in time?

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Bedtime. Ginger can't get a wink of sleep when the baby Pea-Rexes start snoring loudly.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Teasing. Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. Dad argues that he was only playing as they recall all the times when he's been a big teaser.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Days of the Week Badge. After finding out that Mr Wobbly is visiting next Monday, the Squirrels impatiently want to know how long that means they need to wait.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
programme.desc: Calm Down. Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Grapes. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the spectacular acrobatic Grapes working together to perform the most difficult structures to perfection.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Timmy's Mask. Timmy makes a dinosaur mask, puts it on and roars like a T. rex. Timmy loves his mask and won't take it off.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Wren and Solomon's Fun-Filled Day. Wren and her friends search for a ladybird, and Solomon gets to sit at the VIP table.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Camar the Crocodile. Jen has brought in the board game snakes and ladders but has lost the dice.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild
programme.desc: Mandrill and Sand Lizard. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two amazing animals and reveal a surprising connection between them in the wild. This time, it's the mandrill and the sand lizard.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Hairdresser. Award-winning hairdresser Charlotte tells us why she loves using her afro comb to style people's hair.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Cheese Sandwiches. Meagaidh and Tom visit a school to show the children how a search and rescue dog works.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Metal Recycling Centre and Road Sign. Maddie learns how metal is recycled and visits a factory to see how road signs are made.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Digger. Dee encourages a friend to say 'digger', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of diggers - a big digger, a small digger, a dumping digger and a really muddy digger!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Odds and Evens. Children's animation. The Numberblocks play a game of bounceball, with the Even Tops versus the Odd Blocks. Learn about odd and even numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks

programme.title: Wonderblocks

programme.title: Colourblocks

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Yukee

programme.desc: Tá fomhuireán bréige ag JJ agus a chairde. (JJ and his friends have a toy submarine.)

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Tá an crann Alebrije ag sleabhcadh is caithfidh Dora uisce a fháil dó. (The Alebrije tree is wilting, so it's up to Dora to find its rainbow water.)

programme.title: Elmo Anseo
programme.desc: Beidh Elmo agus a chara nua Cliste ag dul i bhfolach inniu. (Elmo explores and discovers more about camouflage with his new friend, Smartie.)

programme.title: Pip & Posy
programme.desc: Ní thaitníonn sé le Pip go bhfuil éan lachan á leanúint. ( A duckling begins to follow Pip around, making him feel uncomfortable.)

programme.title: Olobob Top
programme.desc: Is sióg í an cara nua atá ag Cnag ach níl aon duine eile in ann í a fheiceáil. (Crunch finds a new fairy friend that no one else can see.)

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Iarrann Gekko ar Armadylan é a thraenáil. (Desperate to prove himself, Gekko recruits Armadylan for extra training.)

programme.title: Wussywat
programme.desc: Bíonn an-spraoi ag Wussywat agus a cairde sa sneachta go dtí go bhfeiceann sí fear sneachta Ird agus Ortus. (Wussywat has fun sledging in the snow.)

programme.title: Clifford
programme.desc: Eagraíonn Bn. Uí Chiaráin cóisir le fáilte a chur roimh an bhfear poist nua. (Mrs. Clayton has a party to welcome the new postman.)

programme.title: Woozle & Pip
programme.desc: Faigheann na cairde amach nach gá a bheith mór le bheith láidir. Ní neart go cur le chéile mar a deir na seangáin. (Our friends learn that you don't have to be big to be strong.)

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Buaileann cara Ginger, an Brocailísár óg, cic ar an liathróid i dtreo na Fatadóin. (Ginger's baby Broccolisaurus friend kicks their ball into Potatodon territory.)

programme.title: Dot
programme.desc: Tá bréagán coganta Scratch ar iarraidh. (Scratch's chew toy is missing.)

programme.title: Momonsters
programme.desc: Gléasann na Momonsters suas mar neacha scanrúla. (The Momonsters dress up as scary things.)

programme.title: Cúla4
programme.desc: Níl aon easpa cláracha do dhaoine óga ar Cúla4 - bí ag spraoi agus ag foghlaim in éineacht linn. (Younger audiences will be spoilt for choice with Cúla4 - watch, play and learn.)

programme.title: Charlie agus Lola
programme.desc: Tá rún ag Charlie, Lola, Marv agus Lotta picnic a bheith acu ach tagann drochaimsir aniar aduaidh orthu. (Charlie and Lola are planning a picnic along with Marv and Lotta.)

programme.title: Petronix Defenders
programme.desc: Tá an banphrionsa Petswiper ag cur iallach ar a piongain nua eitilt. (Princess Petswiper makes her new pet penguin fly.)

programme.title: Pat an Madra
programme.desc: Cuirtear i leith Lola go raibh sí ag goid as an siopa. Caithfidh Pat na gadaithe cearta a aimsiú! (Lola is accused of stealing from the shop but Pat knows who the real thief is.)

programme.title: Angelo Rules
programme.desc: Cé acu is fearr a n-éireoidh leis sa rang - Sherwood nó Tracy? (Who will be voted most likely to succeed - Sherwood or Tracy?)

programme.title: Dónall Dána
programme.desc: Milleann Dónall an béile ar gach duine nuair a théann siad chuig bialann ghalánta. (Henry makes sure to ruin the meal for everyone when they go to a fancy restaurant.)

programme.title: Cúla4
programme.desc: Níl aon easpa cláracha do dhaoine óga ar Cúla4 - bí ag spraoi agus ag foghlaim in éineacht linn. (Younger audiences will be spoilt for choice with Cúla4 - watch, play and learn.)

programme.title: Super Simple Amhráin
programme.desc: Amhrán spraíúil faoi rothaí an bhus a bheidh againn inniu. (A fun song about the wheels on the bus.)

programme.title: Blocuimhreacha
programme.desc: Is Gníomhaire Rúnda í Cúig Déag. (Hush, hush! Agent Fifteen here, with a smashing new way to save the day: the Super Special Secret Step Squad!)

programme.title: Blocdhathanna
programme.desc: Tá cluiche ag Corcra ina gcaithfidh na hiomaitheoirí dath a ainmniú chun an cluiche a bhuachan. (Purple presents a game show, where the contestants must name a colour to win.)

programme.title: Pramsáil
programme.desc: Tá Roy agus Caitríona cantalach inniu mar gheall go bhfuil Mamaí ag iarraidh orthu obair tí a dhéanamh. (Roy and Caitríona are grumpy today as Mammy wants them to do their chores.)

programme.title: Lá Le Mamó nó Daideo
programme.desc: Tá Megan leis an lá a chaitheamh in éineacht lena Daideo Páraic. (Megan is going to spend the day with Daideo Páraic.)

programme.title: Ó a Sheáin
programme.desc: Tá Seán ag ligean air féin gur draíodóir é atá ag iarraidh lacha a tharraingt as hata. (Seán pretends he's a magician today, trying to remove a duck from his hat.)

programme.title: Garáiste Gecko
programme.desc: Oíche Shamhna atá ann is an bhfuil taibhse sa gharáiste? Tá Bobby an Bus ag sileadh ola. (Is there a ghost in the garage on Halloween? Bobby the Bus is leaking oil.)

programme.title: Béiríní is a Leabhair
programme.desc: Féachann Gobnait le haithne a chur ar choinín cantalach. An meallfaidh sí é le bronntanas? (Gobnait learns that a homemade gift is a good way to make friends.)

programme.title: Béiríní is a Leabhair
programme.desc: Faigheann na Béirín amach faoin tábhacht atá le rudaí áirithe a dhéanamh gach lá. (The Bears learn that routines can make you feel ready to accomplish your task.)

programme.title: Pikwik Pack
programme.desc: Tá bís ar Mháire agus ar Mhicheál Mac Tíre a seomra féin a bheith acu. (The Wolf Twins are excited to finally get their own room.)

programme.title: Nuair a Bheidh Mé Mór
programme.desc: Samhlaíonn Sonaí a shaol ina dhéantóir trealamh spóirt nuair a bheidh sé mór, le cúnamh ó Shióg na bPost. (Sonaí imagines his life as a sports equipment maker when he grows up.)

programme.title: Zou
programme.desc: Tiocfaidh Zou agus Daideo i gcabhair ar Zoroaster agus ar Zigmund inniu. (Zou and Grandpa help Zigmund and Zoroaster today.)

programme.title: Dee Dee
programme.desc: Tá ceolchoirm ag na Doobydoos inniu ach an mbeidh gach rud i gceart? (The Doobydoo's concert is happening today but will everything go according to plan?)

programme.title: Is Mise
programme.desc: Caithfidh Seoirse an lá le Annjo ag cruthú ealaíne as ábhar ar féidir a athchúrsáil. (Seoirse will spend the day with Annjo making art from recyclable materials.)

programme.title: Ainmhithe Craiceáilte
programme.desc: Ar chlár an lae inniu, beidh madra ar thuras agus moncaí ag spraoi san uisce. (On today's programme, we have a bulldog going for a spin and a duck starts a new diet.)

programme.title: Comhrá
programme.desc: Micheál Mac Giolla Easbuic as Cill Charthaigh i nDún na nGall a bheidh ag comhrá le Máirtín Tom Sheáinín. (Micheál Mac Giolla Easbuic from Kilcar is this week's guest.)

programme.title: The Wonder Years
programme.desc: Níl Kevin in ann bun ná barr a fháil ar rialacha an mhúinteora staire ach ní hé an t-aon duine amháin é. (Kevin has difficulty dealing with his history teacher, who sets impossible rules.)

programme.title: Geantraí
programme.desc: Scoth an cheoil traidisiúnta, beidh John agus Pip Murphy agus Ann Mulqueen ar an gclár. (A lively programme of traditional music featuring John and Pip Murphy and Ann Mulqueen.)

programme.title: The Golden Girls
programme.desc: Cuireann Sophia iallach ar Dorothy agus ar Stan ligean orthu go bhfuil siad fós pósta. (Sophia encourages Dorothy & Stan to pretend they are still married.)

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: Tarraingítear an t-imscrúdaitheoir árachais Dennis Stanton isteach i gcás dúnmharaithe. (Insurance investigator Dennis Stanton becomes involved in a murder case.)

programme.title: Contractors
programme.desc: Bliain nua, tús maith agus tá na conraitheoirí ar a mine ghéire. (It's the new year and our contractors are back hard at work.)
